items.title: Overview
items.description: FHIR Client for Health Assistant, the self-hosted, open-source health records platform. A pull-only connector for external FHIR R4 servers that issue a static access token — it reads the bound patient's record into the Biomarker Engine, labs, medications and appointments.

items.title: Connection & Patient Binding
items.description: Connect a token-issuing FHIR R4 server: base URL, the sealed API-key credential, and the required remote patient binding. Rotation and what the Check Connection action validates.

items.title: Pull (Streams & Cursors)
items.description: What the connector pulls and where it lands: observations into the Biomarker Engine, DiagnosticReports into labs, MedicationStatements into medications, Encounters into examinations — with per-resource cursors, dedup and mapping-gap recording.

items.title: Security
items.description: Where the access token lives (sealed, context-bound, revocable), the fail-closed pull rule, tenant isolation of pulled data, and what the connector deliberately does not do (no push, no SMART-on-FHIR).

items.title: Troubleshooting
items.description: Diagnose a FHIR Client integration: reconnect prompts after revocation, empty pulls, patient-binding errors, unmapped lab codes, and hostile-resource rejections.
